name: [🏁NEW] Track Race
desc:
Welcome to Track Race, the ultimate track and field running simulator on Roblox! Step onto the track, lace up your shoes, and feel the adrenaline rush as you compete against players from around the world in thrilling races!

🏃‍♂️RUN CONTROLS🏃‍♂️
- PC: Spam Q + E to Run
- Console: Spam R1 + L1 (right/left bumpers) to Run
- Mobile: Spam Right and Left Mobile buttons to Run

🚀 Sprint to Victory: Test your speed and endurance in various race types, getting progressively harder each world!
🏋️Train & Win More: Increase your power and stamina by training on the machines during intermission!
🥇Get to the Top & Win Medals: Get Top 3 and have a chance of rolling a random medal!
📦Customize: Buy crates and look cool on the field with custom Starter Blocks and Trails!
🏆Beat World Records: Evolve, Train and get quicker to beat Record Breaking Times in each world!
